facts.text: Students from partner community colleges in Franklin's Pathway Portal get a $298-per-credit tuition rate and free textbooks for bachelor's courses.

sources.title: College Partnership Program | Community Colleges | Franklin.edu

facts.text: Franklin's Tuition Guarantee allows bachelor's and associate degree-seeking students to lock in their first-term tuition rate for up to four years (12 trimesters).
Students can transfer up to 94 community or technical college credit hours toward a bachelor's degree at Franklin.

sources.title: Online College That Accepts Max Transfer Credits | Franklin.edu
